name: Jamarion Davis
strengths: Davis triggers fast on breaking routes and closes cushion on hitches and slants.
Davis supports the run aggressively — willing downhill tackler in the alley.
Davis transitions smoothly out of his pedal and mirrors through breaks without panic-opening.
weaknesses: Davis (listed 5-11) can get boxed on back-shoulder fades when length is tested outside.
comparison: Davis comps to Marlon Humphrey — 5-11 / 6-0 lean CB mold; twitchy hips, aggressive trigger, and run support before the frame fills.
projection: Davis projects as a Year 2 DB contributor (nickel/special teams Year 1). Ceiling: starting boundary/nickel CB — the Columbia ATH who can cover, tackle, and grow into an SEC defensive back.
schemeFit: Davis fits pattern-match / nickel packages that reward trigger speed and alley toughness.
staffNotes: Vault film desk verified 2026-08-08 from Hudl freshman highlights. Comp size-matched (~5-11/6-0).
insiderNotes: Davis is a lean corner who triggers downhill, mirrors with fluid hips, and finishes as a tackler. Length is the question on true press outside — nickel/pattern-match is the natural early path.
recruitingStory: Jamarion Davis is a 2028 Columbia (GA) CB/ATH · listed ~5-11.
angle: Columbia CB tape: trigger + hips + run support.
